name: Sincerely, Your Diary
storyline: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town, the soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside the window, and favorite tracks playing through headphones. A message suddenly pops up, breaking the familiar calm: a simple "hi" from a stranger who found Matt in someone else's photo. What begins as a casual conversation to pass the time gradually becomes a fragile thread connecting two completely different worlds...
summary:
Sincerely, Your Diary is a linear visual novel that unfolds entirely on Matt's computer. The story begins in 2009 in Clarenville, a small town in Newfoundland.

The player reads and sends messages in a late-2000s messaging app, browses Matt's folders, opens the photos the characters talk about in chat and learns more about Matt's life through his personal files. As the story moves on to the next day, so do the views of Clarenville on the animated desktop wallpaper and the sounds of the seaside town.
